column1: # The utterances the offline voice pipeline is measured on (H4.0), with what each should do.
# id | split | bucket | lang | stage | intent | slot | text        (tab-separated)
# Every clip is spoken as "Hey Mio, <text>" — scripts/record.sh shows it that way — so the same
# recordings measure the wake phrase too. `text` is the reference a transcript is scored against.
#   split   dev: used to tune the phrase table, thresholds and prompts. test: reported, never tuned on.
#   bucket  closed    one of the fixed questions or commands
#           found     answerable from local records; slot is "<row label>:<where|when>"
#           declined  mentions something on record, but nothing a record can answer
#           norecord  asks after something never seen — the model must not even start
#           brain     needs the Brain (smart home, calls, the internet)
#           chatter   anything else, including near-misses that contain a command word
#   lang    en, ur (household Urdu, loanwords in Urdu script), mixed (heavier English inside Urdu)
